title: Database Migrations
description: Run schema migrations on startup, add columns dynamically, and verify migration state.

steps.title: Initial schema migration
steps.description: Run a schema migration on startup that creates a users table with id, name, and email columns using CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS. Return 200 from GET /health.
hints: Run the CREATE TABLE statement when the server starts
Use IF NOT EXISTS to make the migration idempotent
Track migration state in a migrations table

codeTemplate.python:
from fastapi import FastAPI
import sqlite3
import os

app = FastAPI()
port = int(os.getenv('PORT', 3000))

db = sqlite3.connect(':memory:', check_same_thread=False)
db.executescript('''
  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS _migrations (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    name TEXT,
    applied_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
  )
''')
db.executescript('''
  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT NOT NULL
  )
''')
db.execute('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO _migrations (id, name) VALUES (?, ?)', (1, 'create_users'))
db.commit()

@app.get('/health')
def health():
    return {'status': 'ok', 'migrations': 1}

steps.title: Verify migration state
steps.description: Ensure GET /health returns 200 and includes the migration count. Verify that the schema migration was applied correctly by checking the _migrations table.
hints: Query the _migrations table to get the count
Include the migration count in the health response
Make sure the server is stable after migrations

codeTemplate.python:
from fastapi import FastAPI
import sqlite3
import os

app = FastAPI()
port = int(os.getenv('PORT', 3000))

db = sqlite3.connect(':memory:', check_same_thread=False)
db.executescript('CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS _migrations (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, applied_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)')
db.executescript('CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, email TEXT NOT NULL)')
db.execute('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO _migrations (id, name) VALUES (?, ?)', (1, 'create_users'))
db.executescript('ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN age INTEGER DEFAULT 0')
db.execute('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO _migrations (id, name) VALUES (?, ?)', (2, 'add_age'))
db.commit()

@app.get('/health')
def health():
    cursor = db.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM _migrations')
    count = cursor.fetchone()[0]
    return {'status': 'ok', 'migrations': count, 'schema': ['id', 'name', 'email', 'age']}
